facts.fact: The Comoros meteorological service (SMC, within ANACM) says it receives the EUMETCast stream through Synergie and PUMA stations running Meteo-France's Synergie software.
facts.system: EUMETCast via Synergie and PUMA stations

facts.fact: ANACM says it produces early warnings (cyclone, heavy rain, strong wind, flood, tsunami) using model outputs and the EUMETCast flux received through its Synergie and PUMA stations.
facts.system: EUMETCast via Synergie and PUMA stations

systems.system: EUMETCast via Synergie and PUMA stations
